en: <CLT=cltMIND>In an instant...
<CLT=cltMIND>We were standing in the other world.

<CLT=cltMIND>Yes...
We were there.
This...is...
So this...is the Virtual World?

It seems like...it's completely different 
from what we were told...

These graphics are really disappointing! How's
this supposed to be better than the real world!?

These avatars are really disappointing, too!
I wanted to have the face of a supermodel!
I thought you liked your face...

I still have a robot body. I must admit, I was
secretly expecting more...

<CLT=cltMIND>So you were hoping for a
change, Keebo?

But...it feels weird. I can move this avatar
like I could my own body, right?

And with this body, I don't have to worry
about all that stuff...
What stuff?
Uh...no, it's nothing.
...I want to go back.
Th-That was quick...

Ooohh, so this is the Virtual World.
I see, I see.

And this is my avatar.
Mm-hm, mm-hm. I get it now.
Ouch!
What did you do that for!?
Ooh, so that hurt.

Oh, well, now that you mention it...I felt
genuine pain just now...

That's pretty impressive. If you felt pain,
then that means our senses are connected.
...Our senses are connected?

This place is so great, I come here all the
time. It's way better than the real world!

What the heck are you talking about, 
you fraud!?
Heeeeeeeeeee!

This is totally different from what you said.
Plus, this avatar has disappointing graphics.

Y-Your looks are nothing to write home about.
Trust me, you look a billion times better now.
What!?

Anyway...what do you mean our senses are
connected? I need an explanation.
H-Huh? Didn't I tell you?
Ouch!

It means that this goes way beyond the realm of
virtual reality! We are *actually* connected!
We get it, so stop hitting me!

No can do! Even if they are avatars, I could
never hit a *person*!
E-Even here...I can't escape your robophobia!
...How are our senses set up?

When your avatar receives any sensory input,
electrical signals are sent to your brain.

Your brain then interprets those signals as if
it experienced that sensory input for real.

So even if we're not really being punched,
the brain senses pain cuz of those signals...

And since it won't leave any bruises,
you can hit all you want!
That's a bully's twisted logic.

Hey! Why our bodies like this!?
This Himiko's magic!?

Well...there's a lot of things going on right
now, but you don't have to worry, Gonta.

So...how exactly are we supposed to find
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
We don't even know where to start looking.

First, we need to learn more about this
world. Is there a map available?

Yeah, I've got a map, but first I gotta give
you a quick warning about this world.

Huh? A warning? You need to be quicker 
on the draw with stuff like that.

I-I'm plenty quick on the draw! But not too
quick, cuz then you can't pull out in time!
Shut up...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what the rules
for this place could be...

Information from our five senses here
is sent to our real bodies...

But it seems like information from our real
bodies isn't sent to our consciousness here.
If that's the case, then...it's fine, but...

We gotta make sure we know how this world 
works. Let's go after Miu and check the map.
So this is "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ver-chewal World<CLT=cltNORMAL>"...
But how we even get here?

Gonta not feel anyone pick him up.
And we got here so fast...

Ah, well, it's like Tsumugi said,
you don't have to worry...

N-No! If Gonta not strong, Gonta no can
protect everyone!

Hey, who Gonta gotta talk to get strong
again!?
I honestly thought it'd be more like an MMO...

But if our senses are connected, then that
means it's just another reality.

You guys better not cheat by logging out alone!
We have to find the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

I never thought it'd be possible to link
our real-world senses with our avatars...

And I never thought a robot had a <CLT=cltSTRONG>consciousness<CLT=cltNORMAL>
to begin with...
...And I thought you would say that.

We're receiving too much information after
the fact... I feel somewhat deceived...

But if the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL> is
really here, we can't turn back now.

On top of the graphics and our senses, 
now there are even more warnings...?
This really *is* fraud!

Oh yeah! I forgot to say something 
really important!

Unfortunately, it seems like I can't 
use my magic here.
So don't rely on me like usual, okay?

<CLT=cltMIND>...I don't recall ever relying
on you in the past.

Unfortunately, it seems like I can't 
use my magic here.
So don't rely on me like usual, okay?

<CLT=cltMIND>...I don't recall ever relying
on you in the past.
...Hurry up with this conversation.

I want to find the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>
and head back to the real world already.
I'm not as strong in this world...

I'm guessing...because it's programmed like
that for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>killing game simulator<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

They want to see what kind of killing game
it'll be when no one has their special talent.
...That's probably the reason.

The graphics here... There are old-school 
games with better graphics than this...

If they were gonna go retro, they should've
gone all the way and had it be all blocky...
Objects won't break...

That may seem convenient at first, but I feel
like it's going to end up being a problem.
So, what do you have to tell us, Miu?

Well, it's not that big of a deal, but there is
a special rule to this world...
...Objects here are unbreakable.
Hm? Objects don't break?

In the Virtual World, there are no rules that
govern whether <CLT=cltSTRONG>objects can break<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

So any object, no matter what it is, can
never be broken.

For example, if you stretch a rubber band
far enough, it'll eventually tear, y'know?

But here, the rubber band would stop stretching
at a certain point, and just not tear at all.

For the same reason, your avatars can't get
injured. You'll still feel pain, though.
See? I told ya it's not a big deal!

What are you talking about!? That's a really big
deal! You gotta tell us stuff like that before!
Heeeeeeeeeeeee! S-Sorry!

B-But...that's the only special thing! In every
other sense, the physics here are the same—

...Oh, wait. That's right... There's a special
thing about the avatars, too...
There's still more!? Spit it out already!
Heeeeeeeeee! I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
And what's special about the avatars?

To make things fair...everyone's avatar in this
world has the same averaged physical strength...

Does that mean there is no discernable
difference in our physical abilities?

So in this Virtual World, I'm just 
as strong as Gonta?

What!? Gonta weaker!?
That also cuz of Himiko's magic!?

N-No! If Gonta not strong, Gonta no can
protect everyone!

I-It's not my fault. That's...just how 
this world is.

...Are those the only things
different about this world, Miu?
Y-Yeah...that's everything.
By the way, how do we log out from this world?

O-Oh yeah, that's right...
I need to tell you that.

If you ever wanna log out, you just need
to use that phone over there.

Just pick it up and say your name.
That simple enough for you shitheads?

Also, that phone is fixed and can't be
removed from that room.

Which means, you have to use this room
to log in and log out.

Whenever you log in, you'll always appear
in this room.
Hmm...okay, got it.

You guys better not cheat by logging out alone!
We have to find the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Yeah, we got it. So where's this map?

The map is posted on the wall outside of
this room. Follow me.

<CLT=cltMIND>What *is* this phone?
What does it connect to?
<CLT=cltMIND>We use this phone to log out...

<CLT=cltMIND>You log out by picking up the
phone and speaking your name.

<CLT=cltMIND>The phone isn't portable, so you can
only log out from this spot.

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose Miu is the only source
of information about this place...
